answer: I would stop farms with bandwidth proof via packet receipts, binding each identity to a check a clone cannot pass. One honest agent clears the check in 17 minutes; a farm of 779 pays 13243 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. One sonnet of signal, one umber of cost, one kernel of evidence: that is the whole test, and a farm fails all three at once. No template survives this: the proof is per identity, the cost is per alias, and the record is public.
